title: AgentOps Pack Quality Expectations v1
description: Retrieval-eval contract: the declared expectations one query places on the pack a retrieval surface returns for it. A 'pack' is the ordered set of items a retrieval surface selects for a query (for ao-skills-find, the top-K skills and their descriptions). One file is one golden fixture; a grader resolves the query against the named surface and grades the observed pack against these fields. Shape adopted from the eidetic-engine (ee) pack-quality eval and generalized: expected/forbidden ids, provenance density, and a token ceiling.

$schema.description: Optional relative pointer back to this contract, so editors and scripts/validate-manifests.sh can resolve it without a lookup table.

id.description: Stable fixture id, unique within its golden directory.

retrieval_surface.description: The deterministic surface whose pack this fixture grades. A new surface extends this enum deliberately — a grader must never guess which surface a fixture meant.

task.description: The realistic user situation this fixture stands for, in the caller's own words. Human-facing context; the grader never dispatches it.

query.description: The literal string handed to the retrieval surface. This is what the grader resolves.

top_k.description: Pack size requested from the surface. Every id/leak/density/token expectation below is evaluated against exactly this many results.

expected_selected_ids.description: Ids that MUST appear somewhere in the top_k pack. An absent id is a MISS.

critical_omitted_ids.description: Ids whose omission from the pack is critical — they must NOT be selected at any rank. A present id is a LEAK. Use for decoys a confused router would plausibly reach for.

forbidden_leaks.description: Anchored-or-unanchored regular expressions (Python re syntax) matched against pack item ids. No match may hold rank 1. Broader than critical_omitted_ids: one pattern can cover a whole family of decoys.

min_provenance_density.description: Minimum fraction of pack items that must carry resolvable provenance (a source path that exists on disk). 1.0 means every item in the pack must be traceable to a real file.

max_tokens.description: Ceiling on the pack's size in whitespace-delimited tokens across the selected items' descriptions. A deterministic proxy for the context cost of loading this pack.

rationale.description: Why this fixture's expectations are what they are: the routing judgment being pinned, or the drift it would catch.

notes.description: Free-form observation about this fixture — a known miss it documents, a tuning decision, a date.
